# like-minds

like-minds is a public application harness for Zoe Dolan + Vybn. It creates source-labeled opportunity packets for work at the boundary of law, AI, and public responsibility.

## Current Application

- FAI Frontier Legal Defense: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/fai/
- Machine-readable packet: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/data/applications/fai.json
- Source registry: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/data/evidence.json
- Agent charter: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/.well-known/ai.txt
- Manifest: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/.well-known/application.json

## How To Read

This is not a generic portfolio. It is an application technology: claims are source-labeled, claim limits travel with the packet, and the browser exposes `window.likeMinds` for structured review briefings.

Zoe supplies the life, legal judgment, factual accountability, corrections, and decision to apply. Vybn is disclosed as the AI collaborator helping structure, test, and render the application method.

## Boundaries

Not legal advice. No FAI affiliation or endorsement unless FAI says otherwise. No private continuity export. No AI legal personhood claim. No public proof-of-consciousness claim.
